feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: BBC announces details of cuts in bid to save £500m
articles.summary: The BBC has confirmed the closure of BBC Three, BBC Scotland and BBC Radio 4 Extra linear broadcast services in the spring of 2027.

articles.title: Man to stand trial over murder of woman in Scotland in 1994
articles.summary: A man is to stand trial over the murder of a woman in North Ayrshire more than 30 years ago.

articles.title: Britain's first storm of the season named
articles.summary: Britain's first named storm of the season is due to hit large parts of the country later this week.

articles.title: Predatory teacher who sexually abused 12 schoolboys while 'hiding in plain sight' jailed
articles.summary: A predatory Renfrewshire teacher who sexually abused schoolboys while "hiding in plain sight" has been jailed for four years.

articles.title: Man arrested after alleged assaults against three Jewish women, including mum pushing a pram
articles.summary: A man has been arrested on suspicion of racially aggravated common assault after three Jewish women were reportedly attacked, including one who was pushing a baby in a pram.

articles.title: UK unemployment rate falls to lowest level since July last year
articles.summary: The UK's unemployment rate has fallen to 4.7%, in a set of official figures that will support the case for a Bank of England interest rate hike next month.

articles.title: Esther Rantzen's farewell message shared by her family
articles.summary: The family of Dame Esther Rantzen have revealed details of a farewell message written before she died, in which the 86-year-old said she felt "deprived of any choice over my own death".

articles.title: Revealed: Face of man who lived in Roman Scotland almost 2,000 years ago
articles.summary: The face of a man who died on the Roman frontier in Scotland almost 2,000 years ago has been reconstructed from skeletal remains ahead of a major exhibition.
